name: Soul
description: Essence, Vitality, Transcendence, Memory, Spirit, Identity.

offensive.name: Unselving
offensive.description: Everything a creature knows how to do is written on its soul. You can read. You can also erase — and copy.

tiers.text: The damage is turned into All-Mighty damage. A creature that is hit or fails its save loses one proficiency of your choice — a skill, a tool, a weapon, or a saving throw — and you gain it, until the end of your next turn.
tiers.card: Damage becomes All-Mighty · take one of their proficiencies — they lose it, you have it, until the end of your next turn

steal.duration: until the end of your next turn

tiers.text: What you take can go deeper. Instead of a proficiency you may take one of its damage resistances or immunities: it loses it and you have it, for 1 minute.
tiers.card: Or take one of their resistances or immunities — theirs becomes yours for 1 min

tiers.text: Or take something it does. Name one of its features, attacks, or spells: it cannot use it for 1 minute, and within that minute you may use it once yourself, with its numbers.
tiers.card: Or take a feature, attack or spell — they can't use it for 1 min, and you can, once, with their numbers

tiers.text: A creature this seal drops to 0 hit points leaves something of itself behind. Choose one thing you took from it: you keep it until your next long rest.
tiers.card: Drop them to 0 and keep one thing you took from them until your next long rest

tiers.text: The damage is turned into All-Mighty damage. A Direct Attack drawn with this is rolled against 10 + the target's Charisma saving throw bonus instead of its Armor Class — the seal is aimed at the soul, and the soul wears no plate.
tiers.card: Damage becomes All-Mighty · a Direct Attack rolls vs 10 + their Cha save bonus instead of AC

tiers.text: A creature that is possessed, Charmed, or dominated by another takes double damage from this seal — and whatever holds it lets go: the possession, charm, or domination ends.
tiers.card: Possessed, Charmed or dominated creatures take double damage · and whatever holds them lets go

dispel.what: possession, charm or domination on the target

tiers.text: The seal finds the spirit wherever it hides. Incorporeal, ethereal, invisible, or projected creatures are struck as if solid and seen, and a creature wearing a shape not its own — shapechanged, polymorphed, or disguised by magic — is forced back into its true form.
tiers.card: Hits incorporeal, ethereal, invisible or projected creatures as if solid and seen · shapechangers snap back to their true form

tiers.text: The soul feels it before the body does. A creature that is hit or fails its save has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws until the end of your next turn, and cannot use Legendary Resistance against your seals during that time.
tiers.card: Disadvantage on Int, Wis and Cha saves until the end of your next turn · no Legendary Resistance against your seals

penalty.disadvantage: Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves until the end of your next turn

supportive.name: Know Thyself
supportive.description: Whatever else is taken, the self is not.

tiers.text: The target has advantage on saving throws against being Charmed, Frightened, or possessed. Once while this lasts, it may reroll a failed Intelligence or Wisdom save as a Charisma save — it remembers who it is.
tiers.card: Advantage vs Charm, fear and possession · once, reroll a failed Int or Wis save as a Cha save

buff.advantage: saves against Charmed, Frightened and possession
buff.reroll: a failed Int or Wis save as Cha, once

tiers.text: The target cannot be Charmed or possessed, and the first time an effect would change its form, mind, or loyalty against its will, it simply does not.
tiers.card: Can't be Charmed or possessed · the first unwanted change to its form, mind or loyalty just fails

tiers.text: It cannot be Frightened either, and anything that tries to read, alter, or command its mind learns nothing and takes Five Times your Verum Modifier in All-Mighty damage for the trying.
tiers.card: Can't be Frightened · anything that tries to read or control its mind learns nothing and takes 5×VM all-mighty

rider.trigger: a creature tries to read or control its mind

tiers.text: The self is absolute. The target cannot be changed by anything it does not choose — not its form, its mind, its memories, or its name — and every ally within 30 feet has advantage on saving throws against all of those.
tiers.card: Nothing changes its form, mind, memory or name unless it chooses · allies within 30 ft get advantage against the same

buff.advantage: saves against charm, possession, fear, transformation and memory alteration

supportive.name: Lend the Self
supportive.description: You are more than you use. Lend some of it out.

tiers.text: The target gains one skill or tool proficiency you have for as long as this lasts. If the target is willing, you may borrow one of its proficiencies instead.
tiers.card: Give them one of your skill or tool proficiencies — or, if they're willing, borrow one of theirs

tiers.text: It may also have one of your saving throw proficiencies, and the two of you share senses: either of you can see and hear through the other as a bonus action, at any distance on this plane.
tiers.card: Also one of your save proficiencies · share senses at any distance on this plane

buff.share: a saving throw proficiency and senses

tiers.text: Lend it something you can do. The target may use one of your features, one of your Complement Effects, or one spell you know, once while this lasts, using your numbers.
tiers.card: Lend them a feature, a Complement or a spell of yours — they may use it once, with your numbers

buff.share: one feature, Complement or spell, once

tiers.text: Two souls, one intent. For as long as this lasts, you and the target share everything: each of you may use the other's proficiencies, features, and senses, and you share a single pool of hit points equal to your combined current total. Neither of you falls while the pool holds.
tiers.card: You and the target share everything — proficiencies, features, senses, and one pooled hit point total

buff.share: proficiencies, features, senses and hit points

control.name: Soulchain
control.description: Every soul is tied to something. You choose what.

tiers.text: A creature that fails has its soul chained to a point, creature, or object of your choice within 30 feet, and cannot willingly move more than 15 feet away from it.
tiers.card: Chained to a point, creature or object you choose within 30 ft — can't willingly go more than 15 ft from it

tiers.text: Chain two creatures that failed to each other: whenever one of them takes damage, the other takes half as much, as All-mighty damage.
tiers.card: Chain two who failed together — whenever one takes damage, the other takes half

rider.damage: half of what the other takes

tiers.text: A chained soul cannot leave. The creature cannot teleport, plane shift, turn ethereal, or leave its body, and it cannot be healed by any creature it is chained to.
tiers.card: No teleport, plane shift, going ethereal or leaving its body · can't be healed by what it's chained to

tiers.text: Chain its soul to yours. While the chain holds, it cannot willingly harm you — its soul would be harming its own — and any damage it would deal you, it takes instead.
tiers.card: Chained to your soul — it can't willingly harm you, and any damage it would deal you, it takes instead

control.name: Unremembering
control.description: What it doesn't remember, it cannot do.

tiers.text: A creature that fails loses the thread: on its next turn it cannot take the same action it took on its last one.
tiers.card: Next turn they can't take the same action they took last turn

penalty.actions: not the same action as last turn

tiers.text: It forgets you. Until the end of its next turn it cannot target you with attacks or harmful effects unless you harm it first — to it, you are no one in particular.
tiers.card: It forgets you — can't target you with attacks or harmful effects until the end of its next turn, unless you harm it

penalty.targeting: cannot target you unless you harm it first

tiers.text: It forgets who stands with it. While the effect lasts it cannot tell friend from foe: it cannot aid its allies, and its first attack each turn goes to the nearest creature, whoever that is.
tiers.card: Can't tell friend from foe — no helping allies, and its first attack each turn hits the nearest creature

penalty.targeting: first attack each turn at the nearest creature

tiers.text: It forgets itself. While the effect lasts it cannot use anything it learned rather than was born with — no class features, no spells, no legendary actions — only instinct, teeth, and fear.
tiers.card: No class features, spells or legendary actions while it lasts — only instinct

creation.name: Kindred Vessel
creation.description: Nothing you make is empty. You leave a little of yourself in all of it.

tiers.text: Your creations carry a sliver of your soul. You can see and hear through any of them within a mile, and a Construct understands you perfectly — it acts on what you mean, not what you say.
tiers.card: See and hear through any creation within a mile · Constructs act on what you mean, not what you say

summon.senses: through your creations within a mile

tiers.text: What you make remembers. You can recall anything said or done within 30 feet of one of your Structures while it stood, and an Object you made always finds its way home — you know where it is, and can call it to your hand from within 30 feet.
tiers.card: Recall anything said or done near your Structures · always know where your Objects are, and call them from 30 ft

summon.memory: your Structures remember what happened near them

tiers.text: Step inside. You may move your mind into one of your creations, leaving your body unconscious but safe where it lies; you act as the creation, with your own Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma, and may draw seals from it.
tiers.card: Move your mind into a creation — act as it, with your own mind, and draw seals from it

summon.inhabit: move your mind into a creation

tiers.text: Something stays. The first Construct you raise this way becomes a being of its own: it keeps its name, its personality, and its memories, and every Construct you draw afterward is that same being returned to you. If it is destroyed, it comes back the next time you call it — changed, perhaps, but still itself.
tiers.card: Your first Construct becomes a persistent being — the same name and memories every time you draw one

summon.persistent: the same Construct returns every time

utility.name: Beyond the Body
utility.description: The body is where you live. It is not all you are.

tiers.text: Touch a creature or object and read the last thing it strongly felt — or the last hand that held it, and what that hand meant. Sense every soul within 60 feet: the living, the spirits, and anything wearing someone else's.
tiers.card: Touch a creature or object to read what it last strongly felt · sense every soul within 60 ft, possessors included

tiers.text: Leave your body. For up to 10 minutes your soul travels up to 300 feet from it — invisible, passing through objects, seeing and hearing — while your body lies unconscious. You cannot touch anything while you are out.
tiers.card: Project your soul up to 300 ft for 10 min — invisible, through walls · your body lies unconscious

tiers.text: Walk in someone's memory. With a willing creature you may enter one of its memories together and live it again, recover a memory it has lost, or give it one of yours to keep.
tiers.card: Enter a willing creature's memory together — relive it, recover what was lost, or give them one of yours

tiers.text: Possess a willing creature for up to an hour: your soul steps into its body and you act through it with your own mind and your own seals, while your body lies safe and empty. Or send your voice into the mind of anyone you have ever touched, wherever they are.
tiers.card: Possess a willing creature for up to an hour and draw seals through it · or speak into the mind of anyone you've ever touched

complementEffects.name: Soul Wound
complementEffects.description: The seal tears something deeper than flesh.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target takes bonus All-Mighty damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6), and loses one proficiency of your choice until the end of its next turn.
effect.card: +1 die all-mighty · they lose one proficiency of your choice until the end of their next turn

steal.duration: until the end of their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Bonus damage increases to two dice, and you may strip a saving throw proficiency instead.
upgrades.card: +2 dice · you may strip a save proficiency instead

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Bonus damage increases to three dice, and you gain the proficiency it lost for the same duration.
upgrades.card: +3 dice · the proficiency they lose, you gain

steal.duration: until the end of their next turn

complementEffects.name: Kindred
complementEffects.description: Two souls standing close enough can share the weight.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, bind yourself to one ally within 30 feet until the start of your next turn. Whenever it takes damage in that time, you may take any part of that damage instead.
effect.card: Bind to an ally within 30 ft — until your next turn you may take any part of the damage it takes

buff.share: its damage, if you choose to take it

upgrades.text: Level 5+: You may bind up to two allies, and the bond lasts 1 minute.
upgrades.card: Up to two allies · the bond lasts 1 minute

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Damage you take through the bond is halved.
upgrades.card: Damage you take through the bond is halved

complementEffects.name: Tether
complementEffects.description: The soul remembers where it was standing.

effect.text: Creatures that fail are tethered to the spot where they stood: until the end of their next turn they cannot willingly end a move more than 20 feet from it.
effect.card: Tethered — can't end a move more than 20 ft from where they stood, until the end of their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: While tethered they also cannot teleport, plane shift, or turn ethereal.
upgrades.card: Also no teleporting, plane shifting or going ethereal

upgrades.text: Level 11+: A tethered creature forced, or trying, to go beyond the tether's reach is snapped back to the spot and takes Five Times your Verum Modifier in All-Mighty damage.
upgrades.card: Forced past the tether: snapped back and 5×VM all-mighty
